author: pieter.janssens@lumivia.be
title: Hiring Ravi Kumar (Backend Engineer, India)
body:
Hi Sophie,

We'd like to make an offer to Ravi Kumar for the Backend Engineer role. He's based in Bangalore, Indian citizen, so we'll need the single permit. Offered salary is in line with the band we discussed.

I'll follow the wiki page and send the file to the Flemish department myself. Anything I should watch out for?

Thanks,
Pieter

---
Reply from Sophie Claes, 2024-02-06 16:40:

Hi Pieter,

Go ahead. Two tips from past cases:
- The diploma needs an apostille (legalisation). In India this can take 3+ weeks, so ask Ravi to start today.
- Ask him to book the medical certificate at an embassy-approved doctor early, the slots fill up.

Send me a copy of everything before you submit so I can double check the salary against the threshold.

Sophie
